title: Halving Subtraction
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

You are given a length-$N$ sequence of non-negative integers $A=(A_1,A_2,\dots,A_N)$.

You can perform the following operation on $A$ any number of times, possibly zero:

- Choose a positive integer $x_0$, and set $x=x_0$. Then, for $i=1,2,\ldots,N$ in this order, do the following:
- Subtract $x$ from $A_i$, and replace $x$ with $\displaystyle \left\lfloor \frac x2\right\rfloor$.

Determine whether it is possible to make all elements of $A$ equal to $0$, and if it is possible, find the minimum number of operations required to do so.

You are given $T$ test cases; solve each of them.

## Constraints

- $1\le T\le 10^4$
- $1\le N\le 30$
- $0\le A_i\le 10^9$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
T
\text{case}_1
\text{case}_2
\vdots
\text{case}_T
```

Each test case is given in the following format:

```
N
A_1 A_2 \ldots A_N
```

## Output

Output the answers for the test cases in order, separated by newlines.

For each test case, if it is possible to make all elements of $A$ equal to $0$, output the minimum number of operations required to do so; if it is not possible, output `-1`.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

给定一个长度为 $N$ 的非负整数序列 $A=(A_1,A_2,\dots,A_N)$。

可以对 $A$ 执行以下操作任意次，也可以一次都不执行：

- 选择一个正整数 $x_0$，令 $x=x_0$。随后按照 $i=1,2,\ldots,N$ 的顺序执行以下操作：
- 从 $A_i$ 中减去 $x$，并将 $x$ 替换为 $\displaystyle \left\lfloor \frac x2\right\rfloor$。

请判断是否可以通过上述操作使 $A$ 的所有元素都变为 $0$。如果可以，求所需的最少操作次数。

给定 $T$ 个测试用例，请分别求解。

## 约束条件

- $1\le T\le 10^4$
- $1\le N\le 30$
- $0\le A_i\le 10^9$
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按照以下格式给出：

```
T
\text{case}_1
\text{case}_2
\vdots
\text{case}_T
```

每个测试用例按照以下格式给出：

```
N
A_1 A_2 \ldots A_N
```

## 输出格式

按照测试用例的顺序输出答案，每个答案占一行。

对于每个测试用例，如果可以使 $A$ 的所有元素都变为 $0$，则输出所需的最少操作次数；如果无法做到，则输出 `-1`。

samples.note:
Consider the first test case.

By performing the operations as follows, you can make all elements of $A$ equal to $0$ in two operations:

- Choose $x_0=3$. $A=(10,4)$ becomes $A=(7,3)$.
- Choose $x_0=7$. $A=(7,3)$ becomes $A=(0,0)$.

It is impossible to make all elements of $A$ equal to $0$ in fewer than two operations, so output $2$ on the first line.
